title_sq: APARTAMENT NE SHITJE 2+1 LIQENI I THATE

description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale, in Liqeni i Thate. The apartment has an area of ​​95m2 and is located on the 3rd floor of a new building with an elevator. It is organized in a distribution corridor, living room and kitchen, 2 bedrooms, bathroom and balcony.
